title: Echelon DeltaBrief v1
description: Schema for a deterministic, hashable, inspectable novelty detection artefact. A DeltaBrief is a structured diff of a corpus snapshot against a pinned baseline, producing classified claims (new, updated, contradicted) with independence collapse and counter-signal evaluation. Designed as a first-class evidence bundle type in the Echelon Theatre Template Library.

brief_id.description: Stable identifier for this DeltaBrief artefact. Format: db_{uuid4} or db_{deterministic_hash}.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of artefact generation. Informational only — not included in commitment hash.

commitment.description: All inputs that determine the DeltaBrief output. commitment_hash = sha256(canonical_json(commitment minus commitment_hash itself)).

commitment_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this commitment object (excluding this field). Proves determinism: same inputs → same hash.

detector_id.description: Identifier for the novelty detection pipeline (e.g. 'delta_brief_generator_v1').

git_commit.description: Git commit hash of the detector codebase.

llm_pins.description: Only present if the detector uses an LLM step. Null or absent for purely deterministic detectors (preferred in v1).

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical prompt template.

normalisation_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical normalisation config (chunking, whitespace, boilerplate stripping, shingling params, dedup thresholds).

independence_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical independence collapse rules (how independence_upstream_id maps sources to clusters).

counter_signal_policy_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical counter-signal evaluation policy (required classes, time window, gap handling).

registry_pin.description: Pin to a specific OSINT source registry version. Same convention as fixture datasets.

baseline_snapshot.description: Defines 'what counts as already known'. Novelty is computed relative to this baseline. Agent-agnostic: defined by sources + time window + query policy, not by any agent's internal state.

baseline_id.description: Stable identifier for this baseline definition.

baseline_source_ids.description: Explicit list of source_ids from the OSINT registry that define the baseline corpus.

baseline_query_policy.description: Committed constraints on how baseline data was collected. Ensures replayability.

revision_policy_handling.description: Committed stance when a source issuer revises historical data.

baseline_snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical baseline descriptor (this object minus this field). Not a hash of the fetched content.

corpus_snapshot.description: The incoming data being evaluated for novelty against the baseline.

corpus_id.description: Stable identifier for this corpus snapshot.

corpus_source_ids.description: Source_ids that contributed to this corpus snapshot.

corpus_snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical corpus descriptor.

independence_collapse.description: Explicit record of how sources were collapsed by independence_upstream_id. Ten mirrors of Reuters = one cluster, one corroborator.

cluster_id.description: Deterministic cluster ID: 'cl_' + sha256(independence_upstream_id)[0:16]. Same upstream always produces same cluster_id.

independence_upstream_id.description: The shared upstream identity that collapses these sources into one corroborator.

member_source_ids.description: All source_ids that share this upstream.

representative_source_id.description: The source_id selected as representative for this cluster (highest priority_bucket, then freshest timestamp).

deltas.description: Classified novelty output. Each claim carries its delta_type so the classification survives flattening.

new_claims.description: Claims present in corpus but absent from baseline. Genuinely new information.

updates.description: Claims present in both corpus and baseline, but with fresher timestamp, stronger source, or updated values.

contradictions.description: Claims in corpus that directly contradict a baseline claim.

discount_rule.description: Precommitted discount rule ID if status is present_discounted.

summary.description: Computed counts for quick inspection and CI echo. Recomputable from deltas — validator should check consistency.

hashes.description: Top-level integrity hashes for the complete artefact.

delta_brief_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical DeltaBrief (entire document minus hashes object).

evidence_bundle_hash.description: SHA-256 of the evidence bundle directory this DeltaBrief belongs to (for Theatre Template integration).

claim.description: A single classified claim. claim_id is deterministic: sha256(canonical(claim_text) + baseline_snapshot_hash + normalisation_rules_hash). This ensures the same claim against the same baseline with the same normaliser always produces the same ID.

claim_id.description: Deterministic claim identifier: sha256(canonical(claim_text) + baseline_snapshot_hash + normalisation_rules_hash).

delta_type.description: Classification of this claim's novelty status. Carried on each claim so the category survives array flattening.

claim_text.description: Normalised canonical text of the claim (post-normalisation, pre-hashing).

first_seen_at.description: Earliest timestamp this claim appeared in the corpus.

source_ids.description: All source_ids that contributed this claim.

cluster_ids.description: Independence collapse cluster_ids that sourced this claim. For corroboration counting.

stance.description: Claim's stance relative to the primary thesis under evaluation. Critical for counter-signal routing.

entities.description: Named entities extracted from the claim (companies, jurisdictions, persons, instruments).

confidence.description: Confidence in the novelty classification (not in the claim's truth).

supersedes_claim_id.description: For delta_type 'update' or 'contradiction': the baseline claim_id this claim supersedes or contradicts. Null for delta_type 'new'.
